title: Clean restore ignores Keep current Save Library choice
steps: Start with a clean destination: saveLibrary=null, activeShowdown=null, legacyShowdowns=null, preferences=null.
Review a format v2 backup whose Save Library contains 1 saved Showdown and has an activeSaveId.
Choose Keep current active state, Keep current Legacy only, Keep current preferences, and Keep current Save Library.
Build the restore plan and apply it.
expected: The explicit Keep current Save Library choice should leave saveLibrary null, so no saved Showdown from the backup is imported.
actual: Because destinationIsClean is true, createCareerModeRestorePlan takes the full-library path even when saveLibraryChoice is keep-current. It writes the backup saveLibrary, clears singleton activeShowdown, and changes the summary active choice to use-backup.
root_cause: The full-library condition is hasBackupLibrary && (saveLibraryChoice === "use-backup" || destinationIsClean), so destinationIsClean overrides the user's explicit keep-current Save Library selection.
checked_against: js/restoreUI.js renderReview explicitly offers Keep current Save Library and Replace entire Save Library with backup.
js/restore.js applyCareerModeRestore uses the full-library candidateRaw produced by createCareerModeRestorePlan.
js/backup.js format v2 backup envelope carries the complete Save Library payload when available.

fix.change: Honor an explicit keep-current Save Library choice even on a clean destination. If clean-destination full restore is the desired default, preselect or clearly require Use backup in the UI instead of overriding Keep current inside the plan.

assumptions: A clean destination has no current Save Library or singleton active Showdown.
The reviewed backup is format v2 and contains a complete Save Library with one saved Showdown.
